London Co Of Virginia decreased its stake in Blackrock Inc (BLK) by 7.86% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. London Co Of Virginia sold 70,839 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.32% with the market. The institutional investor held 830,700 shares of the finance company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $450.01 million, down from 901,539 at the end of the previous reported quarter. London Co Of Virginia who had been investing in Blackrock Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $77.52B market cap company. The stock increased 1.21% or $5.76 during the last trading session, reaching $481.07. About 229,485 shares traded. BlackRock, Inc. (NYSE:BLK) has risen 32.79% since August 3, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 20.22% the S&P500.
London Co Of Virginia, which manages about $12.47B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Post Hldgs Inc (NYSE:POST) by 409,876 shares to 1.17 million shares, valued at $88.54 million in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1.87 million shares in the quarter, for a total of 2.80M shares, and has risen its stake in Versum Matls Inc.
Analysts await BlackRock, Inc. (NYSE:BLK) to report earnings on October, 10. They expect $6.98 earnings per share, up 17.91 % or $1.06 from last year’s $5.92 per share. BLK’s profit will be $1.12 billion for 17.23 P/E if the $6.98 EPS becomes a reality. After $6.66 actual earnings per share reported by BlackRock, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 4.80 % EPS growth.
